appTitle.description: Sets the main application title displayed in the top bar.

pageName.description: Sets the current page or section name displayed in the top bar. Available when settings==false.

menuButtonActivated.description: Highlights the menu button as active. Available when settings==false && inactive==false.

dimmingButtonActivated.description: Highlights the dimming (day/night) button as active. Available when showDimmingButton==true && inactive==false.

appsButtonActivated.description: Highlights the apps button as active. Available when showAppsButton==true && inactive==false.

leftMoreButtonActivated.description: Highlights the left more button as active. Available when inactive==false.

userButtonActivated.description: Highlights the user/profile button as active. Available when showUserButton==true && inactive==false.

userButtonDisabled.description: Disables the user/profile button. Available when showUserButton==true && inactive==false.

tall.description: Increases the height of the top bar for larger touch targets.

wideMenuButton.description: Expands the menu button for wide-rail layouts. Available when settings==false && inactive==false.

showAppsButton.description: Shows or hides the apps button.

showDimmingButton.description: Shows or hides the dimming (day/night) button.

showUserButton.description: Shows or hides the user/profile button.

showClock.description: Whether the bar draws its clock (the `date`, `showSeconds` and `timeZoneOffsetHours` below).

showAppIcon.description: Whether the bar draws the app icon (`appIconName`) before the application title.

inactive.description: Disables interaction and visually de-emphasizes the bar.

appButtonBreakpointPx.description: Controls the breakpoint (in px) for showing/hiding the apps button.

dimmingButtonBreakpointPx.description: Controls the breakpoint (in px) for showing/hiding the dimming button.

appTitleBreakpointPx.description: Controls the breakpoint (in px) for showing/hiding the app title.

userButtonBreakpointPx.description: Controls the breakpoint (in px) for showing/hiding the user button.

appIconBreakpointPx.description: Controls the breakpoint (in px) for showing/hiding the app icon.

settings.description: The settings mode: Close and Back buttons, the application title and the breadcrumb (`breadcrumbItems`) in place of the menu button and the page name. The frame does not use it.

breadcrumbItems.description: The crumbs of the settings mode, one object each: `label` and `href`. A crumb's icon (a template function) is not carried. Drawn only while `settings` is true; the frame keeps its own crumb row.

nAlerts.description: Number of active alerts shown in the counter; 0 shows the idle state.

counter.description: Shows the alert counter when there are active alerts and the button is not flat.

alertType.description: The alert type that selects the icon and colours. The Cadre priorities map onto it as wiki 13 section 11.1 says: Critical level-critical, High alarm, Medium warning, Low caution, Diagnostic empty (no alert colour); level-high, level-medium and level-low draw the same colours as alarm, warning and caution. Empty draws the idle state.

blinking.description: Flashes the bell for active alerts of a flashing alert type (never for caution).

showSilenceButton.description: Whether the silence control is drawn beside the bell. False by default: no Cadre function silences an alarm, so the control stays hidden until one exists.

date.description: The time to draw, an ISO 8601 string in UTC (for example 2026-01-01T09:30:00Z), which the page binds to the current time. The clock does not tick by itself; empty draws NaN.

timeZoneOffsetHours.description: Timezone offset in hours, from UTC. Defaults to 0.

appIconName.description: The icon in the `app-icon` slot, by name (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles); empty puts none. Custom icon representing the application or brand (shown when showAppIcon is true)

commandButtonText.description: The text in the `command-button` slot; empty puts none. Primary command/action button for the current context

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
